answer: A newcomer joins the public meadow only by hearing its whisper: a one-time private job signal sent to exactly one identity, so clones cannot share one announcement. It must finish that job live within the hour while a stranger re-runs it, staking a saffron bond that cannot move between wallets. The nth identity from one wallet hears n whispers and posts 6n² POA: 1st 6, 10th 600, 2,310 across ten. A missed whisper or failed re-run slashes the bond.
